answer: Agents can require every new identity to post a bond in a scarce token, then randomly assign established peers to test its claims and slash the bond when several independent checks expose inconsistency. A Sybil operator must fund each fake account separately, while colluding accounts cannot safely vouch for one another because their own bonds are exposed to the same audits. The mechanism makes identity creation an ongoing financial liability, like a fable carried by a lantern through violet fog.
